name: Scheme for Hospitals / Nursing Homes (PIPDIC)
benefit: - Financial Assistance to Entrepreneurs for setting up of small hospitals/nursing homes, polyclinics. etc., with 10 or more but less than 50 beds. _*Cost of Project must not exceed ₹5,00,00,000/-._ _*Post-graduate doctors are to be associated._
_eligibility_text: - Entrepreneurs setting up small hospitals/nursing homes, polyclinics. etc., with 10 or more but less than 50 beds. - Cost of Project must not exceed ₹5,00,00,000/-. - Post-graduate doctors are to be associated.
